Test Case Name: Filter SPOT: renders non-empty table from array-shaped response
Description: Verify Bug 1 fix: when the online market-filter API returns the real array-shaped envelope (data=[{rows,total}]), the CLI unwraps data[0] and renders a populated table instead of an empty result.
Preconditions:
1. Not logged in - no API credentials required (read-only public market data)
2. okx CLI built via 'pnpm build'

Test Steps:
1. Run 'okx market filter SPOT --limit 5'
2. Observe stdout
Expected Results:
1. stdout contains header 'Total: 3'
2. Table includes column 'instId' with value 'BTC-USDT' and 'last' value '50000'
3. stdout does NOT contain 'No results'
4. stdout does NOT contain 'Total: 0'
5. stderr is empty, exit code 0
Remarks: Root cause of Bug 1: result object is data[0], not data. Existing unit suite packages/cli/test/market.test.ts cmdMarketFilter uses object-shaped fixture (lines 162-194) and MUST be updated to array shape per spec 7.3.1. Reference unwrap pattern: cmdMarketOiHistory (market.ts:469).
